mapper.sql: a.id, a.account_id, a.bank_account_number, b.pin_hash, a.cash_balance, b.balance AS bank_balance, a.currency, a.status, a.version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM Accounts a JOIN Third_Party_Bank b ON b.bank_account_number = a.bank_account_number JOIN Users u ON u.user_id = a.user_id WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND lower(b.email) = lower(u.email)

SELECT FROM Accounts a JOIN Third_Party_Bank b ON b.bank_account_number = a.bank_account_number JOIN Users u ON u.user_id = a.user_id WHERE a.id = #{accountId} AND lower(b.email) = lower(u.email) FOR UPDATE OF a, b
mapper.update: UPDATE Third_Party_Bank SET balance = balance - #{amount} WHERE bank_account_number = #{bankAccountNumber} AND balance >= #{amount}
UPDATE Third_Party_Bank SET balance = balance + #{amount} WHERE bank_account_number = #{bankAccountNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Transactions (account_id, transaction_type, amount, metadata, idempotency_key) VALUES (#{accountUuid}, CAST(#{type} AS transaction_type_enum), #{amount}, jsonb_build_object('source', 'linked_bank'), #{idempotencyKey}::text)
